name: claude-essentials
description: A public marketplace of Claude Code plugins, skills, and agents — install via /plugin marketplace add nerymurillohnd/claude-essentials.

plugins.name: agent-self-knowledge
plugins.description: Stops Claude from answering about Claude Code from memory. Its skill queries the live official documentation, the upstream changelog and the npm registry, then answers with the exact sentence quoted verbatim, the source URL, and the version it verified against — and reports what it could not find instead of filling the gap.

plugins.name: block-no-verify
plugins.description: Stops Claude from skipping your Git hooks or commit signing: only when you ask and approve a scope, its skill installs a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that denies Git commands Claude runs with --no-verify, -n, --no-gpg-sign, core.hooksPath overrides, HUSKY=0, and similar bypasses. Installing the plugin wires nothing, and it never controls your own terminal or CI.

plugins.name: evidence-reader
plugins.description: Makes Claude read documents, spreadsheets, data files and images completely and report back with a receipt for every claim: three read-only agents (documents, tabular data, images) with a shared evidence contract, bundled stdlib extractors for Office, PDF, CSV, JSON and XML, image conversion and cropping for fine print, and a report gate that sends an agent back when its report lacks a completeness checklist. It never creates or edits the files it reads.

plugins.name: ruff-quality
plugins.description: Makes every Python file Claude edits pass Ruff. A plugin hook applies Ruff's safe fixes, formats and re-checks each .py, .pyw and .pyi file with the Ruff already installed in your project or globally, using your own Ruff configuration; asks you before Claude adds a suppression comment or changes Ruff configuration; and keeps Claude working, up to 7 attempts, until the files it touched are clean. Its skill teaches Claude to install, configure, run, integrate and diagnose Ruff from the official documentation.

plugins.name: shell-quality
plugins.description: Makes every shell script Claude edits pass shfmt and ShellCheck. A plugin hook formats each .sh and .bash file with the shfmt and checks it with the ShellCheck you already have installed, in your project or globally, using your own .shellcheckrc and .editorconfig; asks you before Claude adds a suppression directive or changes that configuration; and keeps Claude working, up to 7 attempts, until the scripts it touched are clean. Its skill teaches Claude to install, configure, run, integrate and fix findings with both tools from the official documentation.

plugins.name: verify-completion
plugins.description: Makes Claude prove work is done before saying so: a six-gate verification skill with coherence and depth audits, a read-only verifier agent scaled to the size of the change, an opt-in workflow that cross-checks every finding, and a Stop hook that sends Claude back for a checkable Verification record when a reply presents finished work without one. It never authorizes commits, pushes, or deploys.
